notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38024323/6f8c9cf7806bd70e786260b093630c20887df0fb.png

Update to En-Train 1.1.0 completed.

1. Relocate quests and remove some quests
As we rearranged the order of the quests, we boldly removed the quests that we thought were unnecessary.

2. Dramatically increase the drop rate of monster materials
Monsters drop better general and higher materials.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38024323/d6638c1967b284456ea3ebb71e340ce97b7134fa.png

3. Add New Rare Monsters
Rare species of monsters appearing by region sometimes hit trains!
Rare monsters are more powerful, but they give you materials and blood.

4. Reducing the price of clues sold by merchants
We have reduced the price of clues sold by the merchant.

5. Change World Map Configuration
Map Move selection has changed to a larger selection area more easily. It also indicates where uninvited guests appear.

6. Adjust the length of the stage and adjust the number of stages
Increase the length of the stage and decrease the number of stages.

7. Rebalance Maria's Growth
Maria adjusted to grow with the player.

8. Main Menu Colour Adjustment
The color has been adjusted to make the main menu navigation more visible.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38024323/f6ce9d978f7d7a491f0912d5c460b83a8bf9c3d2.png

9. Fast Forward in the event of player death
A separate selection window is provided so that you can continue or move to the main screen when the player dies.

10. Player Basic Weapon Capability Increase
Increases the basic capabilities of the weapon.

11. Modifying other minor factors

Through this 1.1.0 update, we have made significant changes and improvements to the existing deficiencies.
This may not be a normal link to the existing save.

The update to be a good game will continue in the future!
